name: Mission Control
source: Bodenstation: Navy-Instrumentenfelder, Cyan-Anzeigen, orange Missionsakzente; Marsillustrationen behalten ihre eigene Bildsprache.
extra_css: :root.lia-variant-dark { --mc-panel: #122438; --mc-line: #58778B; --mc-signal: #67DCEC; --mc-mission: #FFB36B; --mc-grid: rgba(103,220,236,.045); } :root.lia-variant-light { --mc-panel: #F3F7FB; --mc-line: #73899C; --mc-signal: #086579; --mc-mission: #99501C; --mc-grid: rgba(8,101,121,.045); } .lia-slide { background-image: linear-gradient(var(--mc-grid) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--mc-grid) 1px,transparent 1px); background-size: 4rem 4rem; } .lia-slide__content { background-color: rgb(var(--color-background)); } .lia-slide__content .h1 { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mc-line); border-left: .4rem solid var(--mc-mission); padding: .6rem 0 .8rem 1.4rem; } .lia-slide__content :is(details,.lia-code__input,.lia-table-responsive) { border: 1px solid var(--mc-line); background-color: var(--mc-panel); } details, details * { text-align: left; } :is(a,button,input,select,textarea,summary):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mc-signal); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 .8rem color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc-signal) 25%,transparent); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .lia-btn { transition: box-shadow .15s ease; } .lia-btn:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 .8rem color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc-signal) 20%,transparent); } } @media (max-width:600px) { .lia-slide__content .h1 { padding-left: .8rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } }
